maddeler.e:
أنفئي (form VII)
# أَنْفَئِي (ʔanfaʔī) /ʔan.fa.ʔiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَأَى (infaʔā)
# أَنْفَئِيَ (ʔanfaʔiya) /ʔan.fa.ʔi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَأَى (infaʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
